A. Opening Page

Welcome to Chapter 3

In this chapter, you will learn how to examine complex issues carefully. Some issues cannot be answered with a simple “yes” or “no.” Many real-life issues have advantages, disadvantages, risks, benefits, supporters, critics, and possible solutions.

Dalam bab ini, kamu akan belajar membaca, memahami, mendiskusikan, dan menulis discussion text. Kamu akan berlatih melihat sebuah isu dari dua sisi atau lebih sebelum mengambil sikap pribadi yang bijak.

Big Question:
How can we examine both sides of an issue before taking a wise stance?
Bagaimana kita dapat memeriksa kedua sisi sebuah isu sebelum mengambil sikap yang bijak?

English: A complex issue needs careful thinking, balanced evidence, and respectful discussion.
Artinya: Isu yang kompleks membutuhkan pemikiran yang cermat, bukti yang seimbang, dan diskusi yang santun.

Gambar siswa belajar ditampilkan setengah halaman sesuai instruksi.

Context for Island and Coastal Students

Students in island and coastal communities may face real issues such as unequal internet access, cash and cashless payment in school and local markets, sea transportation and digital ticketing, renewable energy, tourism development, plastic waste, online work, and AI tools for school projects. These topics are close to your daily life. That is why discussion text trains you to think beyond one side.

Examine both sides

Look at benefits, risks, evidence, and different groups affected by the issue.

Reason carefully

Avoid extreme claims. Use facts, examples, and logical consequences.

Take a wise stance

Your opinion is stronger when it is balanced, respectful, and well-reasoned.

Learning Approach

Genre-Based Approach

Building Knowledge of the Field, Modelling of the Text, Joint Construction, and Independent Construction.

Inquiry-Based Learning

You ask questions, gather arguments, compare evidence, and examine different perspectives.

Discussion-Based Learning

You practice speaking politely, listening carefully, and responding logically.

Project-Based Learning

You choose a controversial topic, collect pro–con arguments, write an essay, and present your stance.

Mindful Learning

You realize that complex issues should not be judged too quickly.

Meaningful & Joyful Learning

You connect the lesson with real life and learn through opinion line, gallery walk, role-play forum, and essay clinic.

E. Learning Input 1

What Is Discussion Text?

A discussion text is a text that presents different viewpoints about an issue. It usually explains arguments for and arguments against the issue before giving a conclusion or personal stance.

English: A discussion text examines an issue by presenting arguments from different sides.
Artinya: Discussion text mengkaji sebuah isu dengan menyajikan argumen dari berbagai sisi.

English: The purpose of discussion text is to examine an issue fairly and critically.
Artinya: Tujuan discussion text adalah mengkaji sebuah isu secara adil dan kritis.

Where Can We Find Discussion Text?

SourceExample
School essayEssay about AI use in student projects
Online articleArticle about cashless payment
MagazineDiscussion about renewable energy
Academic blogBalanced opinion on digital learning
Debate scriptArguments for and against tourism development
Editorial pageDiscussion on environmental policies

Discussion Text vs Other Text Types

Text TypeMain PurposeExample Topic
Discussion TextPresents both sides of an issueShould students use AI in creative projects?
Analytical ExpositionArgues that something is true or importantWhy digital literacy is important
Hortatory ExpositionPersuades readers to do somethingStudents should reduce plastic waste
Argument EssayDefends a position with reasonsOnline learning should be improved
News ItemReports a real eventStudents held a digital literacy seminar
Opinion TextExpresses personal viewI think cashless payment is practical
Discussion Text Sentence:
Some students believe that AI tools can improve creativity; however, others worry that students may become too dependent on them.
Sebagian siswa percaya bahwa alat AI dapat meningkatkan kreativitas; namun, yang lain khawatir siswa dapat menjadi terlalu bergantung pada alat tersebut.
F. Learning Input 2

Generic Structure of Discussion Text

PartFunctionExampleArti Bahasa Indonesia
IssueIntroduces the topic or problem being discussed.The use of AI tools in student creative projects has become a growing discussion in many schools.Penggunaan alat AI dalam proyek kreatif siswa telah menjadi diskusi yang berkembang di banyak sekolah.
Arguments ForPresents reasons supporting the issue.Supporters argue that AI tools can help students generate ideas and save time.Pendukung berpendapat bahwa alat AI dapat membantu siswa menghasilkan ide dan menghemat waktu.
Arguments AgainstPresents reasons opposing the issue.On the other hand, critics believe that students may depend too much on AI.Di sisi lain, para pengkritik percaya bahwa siswa mungkin terlalu bergantung pada AI.
Elaboration / EvidenceGives examples, reasons, possible effects, or evidence.For example, students in areas with limited internet access may not have the same opportunity.Sebagai contoh, siswa di daerah dengan akses internet terbatas mungkin tidak memiliki kesempatan yang sama.
Conclusion / Personal StanceSummarizes both sides and gives a reasoned personal position.After considering both sides, AI should be allowed with clear rules.Setelah mempertimbangkan kedua sisi, AI sebaiknya diizinkan dengan aturan yang jelas.

Common Student Mistakes

MistakeBetter Version
Writing a topic that is too generalWrite a clear issue question.
Giving only one sideInclude arguments for and against.
Using emotional attacksUse respectful and academic language.
Forgetting evidenceAdd examples, reasons, possible impacts, or observations.
Ending without stanceClose with a balanced conclusion and personal stance.
G. Learning Input 3

Balanced Perspective

A balanced perspective means looking at an issue from different sides before making a decision. It does not mean all sides are equally strong. It means you are fair enough to consider different arguments.

English: A balanced perspective helps us avoid judging an issue too quickly.
Artinya: Perspektif yang seimbang membantu kita menghindari penilaian yang terlalu cepat terhadap sebuah isu.

One-Sided vs Balanced Statements

One-Sided StatementBalanced StatementArti Bahasa Indonesia
Cashless payment is always better than cash.Cashless payment can be practical; however, cash is still important for people with limited digital access.Pembayaran non-tunai bisa praktis; namun, uang tunai masih penting bagi orang dengan akses digital terbatas.
AI destroys creativity.AI may support creativity when used responsibly, but it may reduce originality if students rely on it completely.AI dapat mendukung kreativitas jika digunakan secara bertanggung jawab, tetapi dapat mengurangi orisinalitas jika siswa bergantung sepenuhnya padanya.
Tourism is always good for coastal communities.Tourism can create jobs, whereas uncontrolled tourism may damage coastal environments.Pariwisata dapat menciptakan pekerjaan, sedangkan pariwisata yang tidak terkendali dapat merusak lingkungan pesisir.
Renewable energy is too expensive.Renewable energy may require high initial costs; nevertheless, it could reduce long-term dependence on fossil fuels.Energi terbarukan mungkin membutuhkan biaya awal yang tinggi; meskipun demikian, energi tersebut dapat mengurangi ketergantungan jangka panjang pada bahan bakar fosil.
Online jobs are better than traditional jobs.Online jobs can offer flexibility, while traditional jobs may provide stability and direct community interaction.Pekerjaan online dapat menawarkan fleksibilitas, sementara pekerjaan tradisional dapat memberikan stabilitas dan interaksi langsung dengan masyarakat.

How to Disagree Respectfully

English ExpressionArti Bahasa Indonesia
I understand your point, but…Saya memahami pendapatmu, tetapi…
That may be true in some cases; however…Itu mungkin benar dalam beberapa kasus; namun…
I see it differently because…Saya melihatnya secara berbeda karena…
I partly agree, but we should also consider…Saya sebagian setuju, tetapi kita juga harus mempertimbangkan…
From another perspective…Dari sudut pandang lain…
That argument is important, although…Argumen itu penting, meskipun…
H. Learning Input 4

Language Features

1. Contrastive Conjunctions

Contrastive conjunctions connect ideas that are different or opposite. They help writers compare two sides of an issue.

ConjunctionMeaningFunctionExample SentenceArti Kalimat
howevernamunShows contrast between two ideas.Cashless payment is fast and practical. However, some students may not have access to digital wallets.Pembayaran non-tunai cepat dan praktis. Namun, sebagian siswa mungkin tidak memiliki akses ke dompet digital.
on the other handdi sisi lainIntroduces an opposite viewpoint.AI tools can help students create visual designs. On the other hand, students may become too dependent on them.Alat AI dapat membantu siswa membuat desain visual. Di sisi lain, siswa mungkin menjadi terlalu bergantung padanya.
converselysebaliknyaShows reverse relationship or opposing idea.Some people believe tourism improves the local economy. Conversely, others argue that it can increase waste.Sebagian orang percaya pariwisata meningkatkan ekonomi lokal. Sebaliknya, yang lain berpendapat bahwa pariwisata dapat meningkatkan sampah.
whereassedangkanCompares two different facts or situations.Urban students may access online learning easily, whereas students in some island areas may face unstable connections.Siswa di perkotaan mungkin dapat mengakses pembelajaran online dengan mudah, sedangkan siswa di beberapa wilayah kepulauan mungkin menghadapi koneksi yang tidak stabil.
whilesementara / walaupunShows contrast or simultaneous ideas.While renewable energy can reduce pollution, it may require careful planning and investment.Sementara energi terbarukan dapat mengurangi polusi, energi tersebut mungkin membutuhkan perencanaan dan investasi yang cermat.
althoughmeskipunIntroduces a contrasting condition.Although cashless payment is convenient, cash is still useful in areas with limited internet access.Meskipun pembayaran non-tunai nyaman, uang tunai masih berguna di wilayah dengan akses internet terbatas.
neverthelessmeskipun demikianShows contrast while continuing the argument.Renewable energy projects can be expensive at first. Nevertheless, they may provide long-term benefits.Proyek energi terbarukan bisa mahal pada awalnya. Meskipun demikian, proyek tersebut dapat memberi manfaat jangka panjang.
in contrastberbeda dengan ituCompares clear differences.Some students prefer printed books. In contrast, others prefer digital materials.Sebagian siswa menyukai buku cetak. Sebaliknya, yang lain menyukai bahan digital.
despite thismeskipun demikianShows an idea continues after a contrast.Some families are not familiar with digital payment. Despite this, schools may introduce cashless options gradually.Sebagian keluarga belum terbiasa dengan pembayaran digital. Meskipun demikian, sekolah dapat memperkenalkan pilihan non-tunai secara bertahap.

2. Modal Verbs for Showing Possibilities

Modal VerbArtiStrengthFunctionExample SentenceArti Kalimat
maymungkinmediumpossibilityAI automation may help students develop creative ideas faster.Otomasi AI mungkin membantu siswa mengembangkan ide kreatif lebih cepat.
mightmungkinweaker than mayuncertain possibilityIt might reduce originality if students copy AI results without thinking.Hal itu mungkin mengurangi orisinalitas jika siswa menyalin hasil AI tanpa berpikir.
coulddapat / bisa sajaflexiblepossibility or suggestionSchools could use both cash and cashless payment systems.Sekolah dapat menggunakan sistem pembayaran tunai dan non-tunai sekaligus.
candapat / bisastrong abilityability or general possibilityRenewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels.Energi terbarukan dapat mengurangi ketergantungan pada bahan bakar fosil.
shouldsebaiknya / harusnyarecommendationadviceStudents should examine both sides before writing their stance.Siswa sebaiknya memeriksa kedua sisi sebelum menulis sikap mereka.
mustharusstrong obligationnecessityWriters must avoid making extreme claims without evidence.Penulis harus menghindari klaim ekstrem tanpa bukti.
wouldakan / mungkin akanconditionalpossible resultA balanced policy would help different groups adapt gradually.Kebijakan yang seimbang akan membantu berbagai kelompok beradaptasi secara bertahap.
willakanstrong predictionfuture resultBetter internet access will support digital learning in coastal communities.Akses internet yang lebih baik akan mendukung pembelajaran digital di komunitas pesisir.

3. Expressions for Balance

ExpressionArti Bahasa IndonesiaExample SentenceArti Kalimat
There are two sides to this issue.Ada dua sisi dalam isu ini.There are two sides to this issue: convenience and fairness.Ada dua sisi dalam isu ini: kenyamanan dan keadilan.
Supporters argue that…Pendukung berpendapat bahwa…Supporters argue that cashless payment is faster.Pendukung berpendapat bahwa pembayaran non-tunai lebih cepat.
Critics believe that…Pengkritik percaya bahwa…Critics believe that cashless payment may exclude some students.Pengkritik percaya bahwa pembayaran non-tunai dapat mengecualikan sebagian siswa.
Some people claim that…Sebagian orang mengklaim bahwa…Some people claim that AI makes students less creative.Sebagian orang mengklaim bahwa AI membuat siswa kurang kreatif.
Others point out that…Yang lain menunjukkan bahwa…Others point out that AI can be used as a learning tool.Yang lain menunjukkan bahwa AI dapat digunakan sebagai alat belajar.
One benefit is…Salah satu manfaatnya adalah…One benefit is that renewable energy can reduce pollution.Salah satu manfaatnya adalah energi terbarukan dapat mengurangi polusi.
One concern is…Salah satu kekhawatirannya adalah…One concern is that renewable energy projects may be expensive at first.Salah satu kekhawatirannya adalah proyek energi terbarukan mungkin mahal pada awalnya.
From an economic perspective…Dari sudut pandang ekonomi…From an economic perspective, tourism can create local jobs.Dari sudut pandang ekonomi, pariwisata dapat menciptakan pekerjaan lokal.
From an environmental perspective…Dari sudut pandang lingkungan…From an environmental perspective, uncontrolled tourism can damage coastal areas.Dari sudut pandang lingkungan, pariwisata yang tidak terkendali dapat merusak wilayah pesisir.
After considering both sides…Setelah mempertimbangkan kedua sisi…After considering both sides, schools should combine digital and non-digital options.Setelah mempertimbangkan kedua sisi, sekolah sebaiknya menggabungkan pilihan digital dan non-digital.
A balanced solution would be…Solusi yang seimbang adalah…A balanced solution would be to allow AI with clear rules.Solusi yang seimbang adalah mengizinkan AI dengan aturan yang jelas.
In my view, the strongest position is…Menurut saya, posisi yang paling kuat adalah…In my view, the strongest position is to use AI as support, not as a replacement for thinking.Menurut saya, posisi yang paling kuat adalah menggunakan AI sebagai pendukung, bukan pengganti berpikir.

J. Reading Section

Reading Discussion Texts

Setiap teks berikut adalah Sample Learning Text untuk pembelajaran, bukan klaim faktual spesifik tentang sekolah atau komunitas tertentu.

Reading Text 1 • Sample Learning Text

Should AI Be Used in Student Creative Projects?

Topic: Should AI automation be allowed in creative school projects?

The use of artificial intelligence in student creative projects has become an important discussion in many schools. Some students use AI tools to create posters, generate ideas, edit images, or improve presentation designs. This raises a question: should AI automation be allowed in creative school projects?

Supporters argue that AI can help students explore ideas more quickly. For example, students who have difficulty starting a design may use AI to brainstorm colors, layouts, or visual concepts. AI tools may also help students learn modern digital skills that are useful in future careers. In creative industries, technology is often used to support human creativity, so students should learn how to use it responsibly.

However, critics believe that AI may reduce originality if students depend on it too much. A creative project should show the student’s own thinking, effort, and personal expression. If a student simply copies AI-generated work, the project may not reflect real learning. Another concern is fairness. Students with stable internet access may use AI easily, whereas students in areas with limited connections may not have the same opportunity.

From another perspective, the problem is not the tool itself, but how it is used. AI could be useful if students explain their process, mention the tools they use, and add their own ideas. Teachers may also create clear rules, such as allowing AI for brainstorming but not allowing students to submit fully AI-generated work as their own.

After considering both sides, AI should be allowed in creative school projects with clear rules. Students may use AI as a support tool, but they must still show originality, critical thinking, and honesty. In my view, AI should help students think better, not replace their thinking.

Terjemahan Bahasa Indonesia

Penggunaan kecerdasan buatan dalam proyek kreatif siswa telah menjadi diskusi penting di banyak sekolah. Sebagian siswa menggunakan alat AI untuk membuat poster, menghasilkan ide, mengedit gambar, atau meningkatkan desain presentasi. Hal ini menimbulkan pertanyaan: apakah otomasi AI sebaiknya diizinkan dalam proyek kreatif sekolah?

Pendukung berpendapat bahwa AI dapat membantu siswa mengeksplorasi ide dengan lebih cepat. Sebagai contoh, siswa yang kesulitan memulai desain dapat menggunakan AI untuk mencari ide warna, tata letak, atau konsep visual. Alat AI juga mungkin membantu siswa mempelajari keterampilan digital modern yang berguna untuk karier masa depan.

Namun, pengkritik percaya bahwa AI dapat mengurangi orisinalitas jika siswa terlalu bergantung padanya. Proyek kreatif seharusnya menunjukkan pemikiran, usaha, dan ekspresi pribadi siswa. Kekhawatiran lain adalah keadilan karena siswa dengan akses internet stabil mungkin lebih mudah menggunakan AI.

Dari sudut pandang lain, masalahnya bukan alat itu sendiri, tetapi cara penggunaannya. AI dapat berguna jika siswa menjelaskan proses, menyebutkan alat yang dipakai, dan menambahkan ide sendiri.

Setelah mempertimbangkan kedua sisi, AI sebaiknya diizinkan dalam proyek kreatif sekolah dengan aturan yang jelas. Menurut saya, AI sebaiknya membantu siswa berpikir lebih baik, bukan menggantikan pemikiran mereka.

Reading Text 2 • Sample Learning Text

Should Schools Become Cashless?

Topic: Should schools move toward a cashless payment system?

Cashless payment has become more common in many places, including shops, transportation services, and online platforms. Some schools are also considering cashless systems for canteens, uniforms, books, or school events. This creates an important question: should schools move toward a fully cashless payment system?

Supporters argue that cashless payment can make school transactions faster and more organized. Students do not need to carry much cash, and schools can record payments more easily. Cashless systems may also reduce long queues in canteens or school offices. For students who are already familiar with digital wallets, this system can be practical and efficient.

On the other hand, critics point out that a fully cashless system may not be fair for everyone. Some students may not have smartphones, digital wallets, or stable internet access. In island and coastal communities, internet connection may be different from one area to another. Some families may also prefer cash because it is easier to control daily spending. If a school becomes fully cashless too quickly, some students may feel excluded.

Another concern is digital safety. Students should understand how to protect passwords, avoid scams, and check transactions. Without proper guidance, cashless payment might create new problems. However, rejecting digital payment completely may also prevent students from learning important financial technology skills.

After examining both sides, schools should not become fully cashless immediately. A balanced solution would be to provide both cash and cashless options while teaching students digital financial literacy. In my opinion, flexibility is the fairest choice because it respects different levels of access and readiness.

Terjemahan Bahasa Indonesia

Pembayaran non-tunai telah menjadi lebih umum di banyak tempat, termasuk toko, layanan transportasi, dan platform online. Sebagian sekolah juga mempertimbangkan sistem non-tunai untuk kantin, seragam, buku, atau kegiatan sekolah.

Pendukung berpendapat bahwa pembayaran non-tunai dapat membuat transaksi sekolah lebih cepat dan lebih teratur. Sistem ini juga mungkin mengurangi antrean panjang di kantin atau kantor sekolah.

Di sisi lain, para pengkritik menunjukkan bahwa sistem yang sepenuhnya non-tunai mungkin tidak adil bagi semua orang. Sebagian siswa mungkin tidak memiliki ponsel pintar, dompet digital, atau akses internet yang stabil.

Kekhawatiran lain adalah keamanan digital. Siswa sebaiknya memahami cara melindungi kata sandi, menghindari penipuan, dan memeriksa transaksi.

Setelah memeriksa kedua sisi, sekolah sebaiknya tidak menjadi sepenuhnya non-tunai secara langsung. Solusi yang seimbang adalah menyediakan pilihan tunai dan non-tunai sambil mengajarkan literasi keuangan digital kepada siswa.

Reading Text 3 • Sample Learning Text

Should Coastal Communities Be Required to Use Renewable Energy?

Topic: Renewable energy mandates in island/coastal communities

Energy is an important part of daily life. Students need electricity for learning, families need it for household activities, and communities need it for economic development. In many coastal and island areas, people also discuss whether renewable energy should become mandatory. Renewable energy includes solar power, wind energy, and other sources that can be naturally renewed.

Supporters argue that renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels. Solar panels, for example, may be useful in areas with strong sunlight. Renewable energy can also reduce pollution and support environmental protection. For coastal communities that depend on the sea, protecting the environment is very important. Cleaner energy may help communities build a more sustainable future.

Nevertheless, critics believe that making renewable energy mandatory may create financial pressure. The initial cost of installing solar panels or other systems can be high. Some communities may not have enough technical support to maintain the equipment. In addition, renewable energy systems may need careful planning because weather conditions can affect energy production.

Another perspective is that renewable energy should be introduced gradually. Instead of forcing all families or schools to change immediately, local communities could start with public facilities such as schools, health centers, or community halls. Training and government support would also be important.

After considering both sides, renewable energy should be encouraged strongly, but mandatory rules must be applied carefully. In my view, a gradual approach is wiser because it supports environmental protection without ignoring economic readiness and technical needs.

Terjemahan Bahasa Indonesia

Energi adalah bagian penting dari kehidupan sehari-hari. Siswa membutuhkan listrik untuk belajar, keluarga membutuhkannya untuk aktivitas rumah tangga, dan masyarakat membutuhkannya untuk perkembangan ekonomi.

Pendukung berpendapat bahwa energi terbarukan dapat mengurangi ketergantungan pada bahan bakar fosil. Energi terbarukan juga dapat mengurangi polusi dan mendukung perlindungan lingkungan.

Meskipun demikian, para pengkritik percaya bahwa mewajibkan energi terbarukan dapat menciptakan tekanan finansial. Biaya awal pemasangan dan kebutuhan dukungan teknis perlu dipertimbangkan.

Sudut pandang lain adalah bahwa energi terbarukan sebaiknya diperkenalkan secara bertahap dari fasilitas umum seperti sekolah, pusat kesehatan, atau balai masyarakat.

Setelah mempertimbangkan kedua sisi, energi terbarukan sebaiknya sangat didorong, tetapi aturan wajib harus diterapkan dengan hati-hati.

Reading Text 4 • Sample Learning Text

Should Coastal Tourism Be Expanded?

Topic: Tourism development and environmental protection in coastal communities

Tourism development is often seen as a way to improve local economies. In coastal communities, beaches, sea views, local food, traditional arts, and marine activities can attract visitors. However, tourism development is a complex issue because it can bring both opportunities and challenges.

Supporters argue that tourism can create jobs for local people. Families may earn income from food stalls, boat services, homestays, guiding services, or local crafts. Tourism may also encourage communities to improve public facilities such as roads, waste bins, toilets, and information boards. If managed well, tourism can make young people proud of their local culture and environment.

On the other hand, critics warn that uncontrolled tourism may damage coastal areas. More visitors can mean more plastic waste, traffic, noise, and pressure on clean water. Some businesses may focus only on profit and ignore environmental protection. Local traditions may also be changed if tourism is developed without respecting community values.

A balanced view suggests that tourism should not be expanded without clear rules. Communities may need visitor limits, waste management plans, local business protection, environmental education, and fair participation for residents. Tourism should support local life, not replace it.

After examining both sides, coastal tourism can be expanded only if it is responsible, community-based, and environmentally careful. In my opinion, tourism should be developed slowly and wisely so that economic benefits do not destroy the natural and cultural resources that make the community special.

Terjemahan Bahasa Indonesia

Pengembangan pariwisata sering dipandang sebagai cara untuk meningkatkan ekonomi lokal. Di komunitas pesisir, pantai, pemandangan laut, makanan lokal, seni tradisional, dan aktivitas laut dapat menarik pengunjung.

Pendukung berpendapat bahwa pariwisata dapat menciptakan pekerjaan bagi masyarakat lokal. Pariwisata juga dapat mendorong masyarakat memperbaiki fasilitas umum dan membuat generasi muda bangga pada budaya lokal.

Di sisi lain, para pengkritik memperingatkan bahwa pariwisata yang tidak terkendali dapat merusak wilayah pesisir. Lebih banyak pengunjung dapat berarti lebih banyak sampah plastik, kebisingan, dan tekanan terhadap air bersih.

Pandangan yang seimbang menyarankan bahwa pariwisata tidak boleh diperluas tanpa aturan yang jelas, seperti pembatasan pengunjung, pengelolaan sampah, perlindungan usaha lokal, dan partisipasi warga.

Setelah memeriksa kedua sisi, pariwisata pesisir dapat diperluas hanya jika bertanggung jawab, berbasis komunitas, dan berhati-hati terhadap lingkungan.

Buka Script Listening dan Klik Kalimat TTS
Moderator: Good morning, everyone. Welcome to our student panel discussion. Today, we will discuss the question: should AI be used in student creative projects?
Student 1, Supporter: In my opinion, AI can be useful for creative projects. It can help students generate ideas, choose colors, and improve layouts. Some students may have good ideas but do not know how to visualize them. AI could help them start the creative process.
Moderator: Thank you. So, you believe AI can support creativity. What about you?
Student 2, Concerned Student: I understand that AI can help, but I am concerned about originality. If students use AI too much, their projects may not show their own thinking. Some students might copy AI results without understanding the process. That would not be fair.
Moderator: That is an important concern. What is your view, Teacher?
Teacher: Both arguments are reasonable. AI may support learning, but it should not replace students’ effort. Schools should create clear guidelines. For example, students may use AI for brainstorming, but they must explain which parts are their own ideas and which parts were supported by AI.
Student 1: I agree with that. AI should be used as a tool, not as a shortcut. Students should still develop their own concepts.
Student 2: Yes, and teachers should also consider students who have limited internet access. If AI is required, not all students will have the same opportunity.
Teacher: Exactly. Fairness is important. A balanced policy could allow AI use but also provide alternatives for students with limited access.
Moderator: After listening to both sides, it seems that AI can be useful if it is used responsibly. However, schools must protect originality, fairness, and honesty. Thank you for joining today’s discussion.

Terjemahan Singkat

Moderator membuka diskusi tentang penggunaan AI dalam proyek kreatif siswa. Siswa pendukung menyatakan AI dapat membantu ide dan desain. Siswa yang khawatir menekankan masalah orisinalitas dan ketergantungan. Guru memberi nasihat seimbang: AI boleh mendukung proses belajar, tetapi tidak boleh menggantikan usaha siswa; sekolah perlu panduan jelas dan memperhatikan keadilan akses.

Saya setuju. Pendekatan bertahap akan lebih realistis.

Moderator Leading a Balanced Discussion

Moderator: Today, we will discuss whether coastal tourism should be expanded. Let us hear the supporting argument first.
Hari ini, kita akan membahas apakah pariwisata pesisir sebaiknya diperluas. Mari kita dengarkan argumen pendukung terlebih dahulu.

Speaker 1: Tourism can create jobs and support local businesses.
Pariwisata dapat menciptakan pekerjaan dan mendukung usaha lokal.

Speaker 2: Uncontrolled tourism may increase waste and damage coastal areas.
Pariwisata yang tidak terkendali dapat meningkatkan sampah dan merusak wilayah pesisir.

Moderator: Both points are important. What balanced solution can we suggest?
Kedua poin tersebut penting. Solusi seimbang apa yang dapat kita sarankan?

Personal Stance Presentation

Student: After considering both sides, I believe tourism should be developed carefully. It can support the local economy, but it must include strict waste management and community participation.
Setelah mempertimbangkan kedua sisi, saya percaya pariwisata sebaiknya dikembangkan dengan hati-hati. Pariwisata dapat mendukung ekonomi lokal, tetapi harus mencakup pengelolaan sampah yang ketat dan partisipasi masyarakat.

N. Writing Section

How to Write a Discussion Essay

Menulis discussion essay harus bertahap. Kamu tidak langsung menulis sikap pribadi; kamu perlu memahami isu, menyiapkan argumen pro dan kontra, lalu menulis kesimpulan yang seimbang.

Writing Steps

StepWhat You DoExample / Artinya
1. Choose a topicChoose one complex issue.Should AI be used in student creative projects? / Apakah AI sebaiknya digunakan dalam proyek kreatif siswa?
2. Identify the issueWrite your main question.Should schools move toward a fully cashless payment system? / Apakah sekolah sebaiknya beralih ke sistem pembayaran sepenuhnya non-tunai?
3. Make a pro-con tableList arguments for and against.Cashless: faster records; Cash: useful without internet.
4. Collect evidence and reasoningUse examples, observations, logical reasoning, and possible consequences.A strong argument needs reasons, examples, and possible consequences.
5. Write the issue paragraphIntroduce why the topic matters.Some people believe…, while others argue…
6. Write arguments forPresent at least three supporting arguments.Supporters argue that… One advantage is…
7. Write arguments againstPresent at least three opposing arguments.On the other hand, critics believe that…
8. Use language featuresUse contrastive conjunctions, modal verbs, and balance expressions.However, might, could, after considering both sides.
9. Write balanced conclusionSummarize and state your personal stance.After considering both sides, I believe that…
10. ReviseCheck clarity, balance, grammar, and coherence.Does my essay include both sides?

Essay Structure Template

ParagraphContent
TitleWrite a clear title.
Paragraph 1: IssueIntroduce the issue. Explain why it matters.
Paragraph 2: Arguments ForPresent at least three supporting arguments.
Paragraph 3: Arguments AgainstPresent at least three opposing arguments.
Paragraph 4: Balanced AnalysisCompare both sides. Explain conditions, limitations, or possible solutions.
Paragraph 5: Conclusion and Personal StanceState your final position with strong reasoning.

Pro-Con Planning Table

TopicArguments ForEvidence/ReasonArguments AgainstEvidence/Reason

2.2.

Joint Construction Example

Should Schools Use Both Cash and Cashless Payment?

The issue of school payment systems has become more important as digital payment grows in daily life. Some people believe that schools should become fully cashless because it is faster and more modern. However, others argue that cash is still necessary, especially for students who have limited access to digital devices or stable internet.

Supporters of cashless payment argue that it can make transactions more efficient. Students may pay for canteen food, books, or school activities without carrying much cash. This system can also help schools record payments more accurately. In addition, students can learn digital financial skills that may be useful in the future.

On the other hand, a fully cashless system may not be fair for every student. Some students may not have smartphones or digital wallets. Others may live in areas where internet connection is unstable. If cashless payment becomes the only option, these students might face difficulties in daily school activities. Digital safety is another concern because students need to understand passwords, scams, and transaction records.

A balanced solution would be to use both cash and cashless payment. Schools could introduce digital payment gradually while still accepting cash. Students should also receive guidance about safe digital transactions. This approach may help students learn modern financial skills without excluding those who are not ready.

After considering both sides, I believe schools should not become fully cashless immediately. Cashless payment can be useful, but flexibility is more important. A fair school payment system should support efficiency, safety, and equal access for all students.

Terjemahan Bahasa Indonesia Joint Construction Example

Isu sistem pembayaran sekolah menjadi lebih penting seiring berkembangnya pembayaran digital dalam kehidupan sehari-hari. Sebagian orang percaya sekolah sebaiknya sepenuhnya non-tunai karena lebih cepat dan modern. Namun, yang lain berpendapat bahwa uang tunai masih diperlukan, terutama bagi siswa dengan akses terbatas terhadap perangkat digital atau internet stabil.

Pendukung pembayaran non-tunai berpendapat sistem ini dapat membuat transaksi lebih efisien. Di sisi lain, sistem sepenuhnya non-tunai mungkin tidak adil bagi setiap siswa karena ada yang tidak memiliki ponsel pintar, dompet digital, atau koneksi internet stabil. Solusi seimbang adalah menggunakan kedua pilihan sambil memberi panduan keamanan transaksi digital.

O. Mini Lab

Two Sides, One Wise Decision

Praktikum mini ini membantu kamu menilai isu dari dua sisi sebelum mengambil posisi.

Purpose

You will learn to examine an issue from two sides before taking a position.

Suggested Issues

AI in creative projects, cashless payment, plastic packaging ban, coastal tourism, renewable energy in schools, online work skills before graduation.

Steps

  1. Choose one issue close to your life.
  2. Write the main question.
  3. Collect at least three supporting arguments.
  4. Collect at least three opposing arguments.
  5. Add reasons or examples.
  6. Consider the impact on students, school, family, coastal community, and environment.
  7. Write your balanced personal stance.
  8. Present your result in two minutes.

P. Grammar Practice

Practice

Practice 1: Contrastive Conjunctions

Complete the sentences with suitable conjunctions: however, on the other hand, whereas, although, nevertheless.

  1. Cashless payment is practical. , it may not be accessible for every student.
  2. AI can help students generate ideas, it may reduce originality if used carelessly.
  3. Some students have stable internet access, others often face connection problems.
  4. Renewable energy projects can be expensive at first. , they may provide long-term benefits.
  5. Tourism can create jobs. , uncontrolled tourism can damage coastal areas.
Kunci Jawaban

1. However 2. Although 3. whereas 4. Nevertheless 5. On the other hand

Practice 2: Modal Verbs

  1. Students __________ mention when they use AI tools in a project. A. should B. might C. can D. would E. will
  2. Renewable energy __________ reduce pollution in coastal areas. A. can B. must C. should D. would E. might
  3. A fully cashless system __________ exclude students without smartphones. A. might B. must C. will always D. should E. can never
  4. Schools __________ create fair rules before allowing AI in projects. A. should B. might C. may D. could E. would
  5. Digital payment __________ be useful if students understand online safety. A. could B. must not C. cannot D. never E. should not
Kunci Jawaban

1. A 2. A 3. A 4. A 5. A

Practice 3: Rewrite One-Sided Statements

  1. AI is always bad for students.
  2. Cashless payment is perfect for every school.
  3. Tourism always helps coastal communities.
  4. Renewable energy is impossible to use in small communities.
  5. Online jobs are better than all traditional jobs.
Suggested Answers
  1. AI may create problems if students depend on it too much; however, it can support learning when used responsibly.
    AI dapat menimbulkan masalah jika siswa terlalu bergantung padanya; namun, AI dapat mendukung pembelajaran jika digunakan secara bertanggung jawab.
  2. Cashless payment can be practical; nevertheless, schools should consider students with limited digital access.
    Pembayaran non-tunai dapat praktis; meskipun demikian, sekolah sebaiknya mempertimbangkan siswa dengan akses digital terbatas.
  3. Tourism can create jobs, but uncontrolled tourism may damage coastal environments.
    Pariwisata dapat menciptakan pekerjaan, tetapi pariwisata yang tidak terkendali dapat merusak lingkungan pesisir.
  4. Renewable energy may require high initial costs; however, gradual use in public facilities could be realistic.
    Energi terbarukan mungkin membutuhkan biaya awal yang tinggi; namun, penggunaan bertahap di fasilitas umum dapat menjadi realistis.
  5. Online jobs can offer flexibility, whereas traditional jobs may provide stability and direct community service.
    Pekerjaan online dapat menawarkan fleksibilitas, sedangkan pekerjaan tradisional dapat memberikan stabilitas dan layanan langsung kepada masyarakat.

True / False with Reasons

No.StatementAnswerReason
1Discussion text presents only one side of an issue.FalseDiscussion text presents different viewpoints.
2A balanced essay should include arguments for and against.TrueBalanced discussion includes both sides.
3“However” is used to show contrast.TrueHowever menunjukkan kontras.
4Modal verbs can help writers express possibility.TrueMay, might, and could show possibility.
5A personal stance should ignore evidence.FalsePersonal stance should be based on reasoning and evidence.
6“Should” can be used to give recommendation.TrueShould gives advice or recommendation.
7A one-sided argument is always more academic.FalseAcademic writing should be fair and balanced.
8Discussion text can help students think critically.TrueIt trains students to compare viewpoints.
9“Whereas” can compare two different situations.TrueWhereas shows contrast between two clauses.
10A conclusion should connect with the arguments in the essay.TrueConclusion should respond to the discussion.

S. Final Project

Balanced Discussion Essay

You will write a comprehensive, balanced discussion essay on a controversial contemporary topic. Your essay must present both sides of the issue and end with your personal stance.

Essay Length

700–900 words.

Final Message

Examine both sides, reason carefully, and take a wise stance.
Periksa kedua sisi, bernalarlah dengan cermat, dan ambillah sikap yang bijak.

No.Topic
1Should AI be allowed in student creative projects?
2Should schools become fully cashless?
3Should renewable energy be mandatory in coastal communities?
4Should tourism development be expanded in coastal areas?
5Should plastic packaging be banned in school canteens?
6Should students prepare for online work after graduation?
7Should digital learning continue after face-to-face learning returns?
8Should public transportation between islands become fully digital-ticketed?
